scope: Same eight previously evaluated development recordings; one Sol call; exploratory comparison only

primary_paired_comparison.bootstrap_caution: This resamples eight utterances within one recording block; it is descriptive, cannot estimate between-block/participant variation, and is not population-level evidence.

text_splice_target_coverage.note: Coverage checked only after configuration/prediction locks and final evaluation; not used to tune the candidate generator.

runtime.caution: The 0.17-s assembly time excludes neural-retrieval evidence generation. Sol wall time includes its adaptive retrieval/tool work; these are not matched end-to-end costs.

interpretation: The frozen neural retrieval evidence supports substantial novel-sentence assembly without an LLM. Sol reduced four additional edit errors in this small development set. The result does not establish a distinctive neural-decoding paradigm, robust superiority, or a causal benefit of internal reasoning alone. The deterministic word-boundary estimator is deliberately explicit and imperfect; a stronger algorithmic assembler may close the remaining gap.
separation: No conventional decoder weights, predictions, or output files were written into a Sol sandbox; only outputs/.../code and outputs/.../evaluation/algorithm_sentence_baselines were written.
